custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

English-Wizard.question: ১) She was too excited to sleep. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: She was so excited that she could not have sleep.
English-Wizard.option2: She was so excited that she can not sleep.
English-Wizard.option3: She was very excited and she could not sleep.
English-Wizard.option4: She was so excited that she could not sleep.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Simple sentence কে Complex বাক্যে পরিণত করার ক্ষেত্রে:
- too এর আগ পর্যন্ত অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।
- প্রথমে too উঠে গিয়ে so বসে।
- that বসে।
- প্রথম subject পুনরায় বসে।
- tense অনুযায়ী cannot/could not বসে।
- to উঠে যায়।
- sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসে।

• Structure: too এর আগ পর্যন্ত অপরিবর্তিত + too উঠে গিয়ে so + that + প্রথম subject পুনরায় বসে + tense অনুযায়ী cannot/could not + to উঠে যায় + sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসে।

Simple: She was too excited to sleep.
Complex: She was so excited that she could not sleep.

English-Wizard.question: ২) What does the idiom "A fish out of water" mean?
English-Wizard.option1: Someone who is swimming very well
English-Wizard.option2: Someone who is out of their usual surroundings and feels uncomfortable
English-Wizard.option3: Someone who is an expert in their field
English-Wizard.option4: Someone who is very comfortable in their environment
English-Wizard.exp:
• The idiom "A fish out of water" means - Someone who is out of their usual surroundings and feels uncomfortable.

• A fish out of water
English Meaning: someone who is uncomfortable in a specific situation.
Bangla Meaning: অস্বস্তিকর অবস্থা / বেকায়দা অবস্থা

Ex. Sentence: I felt like a fish out of water at my new school.
Bangla Meaning: আমি আমার নতুন স্কুলে খুব অস্বস্তিতে ছিলাম।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ৩) It is found nowhere but in Argentina. (Make it affirmative)
English-Wizard.option1: It is found only in Argentina.
English-Wizard.option2: It is found everywhere but in Argentina.
English-Wizard.option3: None but only it is found in Argentina.
English-Wizard.option4: It is alone found in Argentina.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Transformation এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Negative এ Nowhere but থাকলে Affirmative এ only বসবে।
- এবং এটা স্থানকে Modify করবে। 

Negative: It is found nowhere but in Argentina.
Affirmative: It is found only in Argentina.

English-Wizard.question: ৪) If someone is said to have the "Gift of the gab," what are they particularly good at?
English-Wizard.option1: Singing beautifully
English-Wizard.option2: Telling jokes
English-Wizard.option3: Speaking convincingly
English-Wizard.option4: Cooking delicious meals
English-Wizard.exp:
• If someone is said to have the "Gift of the gab," they are particularly good at - Speaking convincingly.

• Gift of the gab
English Meaning: the ability to speak with eloquence and fluency / the ability to speak easily and confidently.
Bangla Meaning: বাকপটু হওয়া / আত্মবিশ্বাসের সাথে কথা বলার ক্ষমতা।

Ex. Sentence: She's got the gift of the gab - she should work in sales and marketing.
Bangla Meaning: সে খুব বাকপটু, তার সেলস এবং মার্কেটিং এ কাজ করা উচিত।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ৫) Besides eating rice, he took coffee. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: He not only ate rice but also took coffee.
English-Wizard.option2: He ate rice and also took coffee.
English-Wizard.option3: Not only he eat rice but also took coffee.
English-Wizard.option4: He ate both rice and coffee.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Simple to compound: 

• Simple sentence এ “besides” থাকলে compound sentence এ “not only..….but also” structure ব্যবহার করে compound sentence টি গঠন করতে হয়।

Simple: Besides eating rice, he took coffee.
Compound: He not only ate rice but also took coffee.

English-Wizard.question: ৬) The idiom "Half a chance" is often used to express the idea that someone:
English-Wizard.option1: Is reluctant to take risks
English-Wizard.option2: Desires a second chance
English-Wizard.option3: Is uncertain about their chances
English-Wizard.option4: Needs only a small opportunity to succeed
English-Wizard.exp:
• The idiom "Half a chance" is often used to express the idea that someone: Needs only a small opportunity to succeed.

• Half a chance
English Meaning: the slightest opportunity.
Bangla Meaning: ক্ষীণতম সুযোগ / কিছু সুযোগ।

Ex. Sentence: Given half a chance he can make anything work.
Bangla Meaning: সামান্য সুযোগ পেলে সে যেকোনো কিছু করতে পারে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ৭) He had done the work and went home. (Simple)
English-Wizard.option1: As He had done the work, he went home.
English-Wizard.option2: Being done the work, he went home.
English-Wizard.option3: Having done the work, he went home.
English-Wizard.option4: Because of being done the work, he went home.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Compound: He had done the work and went home.
• Simple: Having done the work, he went home.

• এই ধরনের sentence কে simple করার সময়,
- যে কাজটি আগে করা হয়েছে সেই verb টিকে non finite(ing যুক্ত) করতে হয়।
- এখানে 'had done' non-finite হয়ে having done হয়েছে।
- প্রথম বাক্যের মূল verb এর পরের অংশ বসে।
- and এর পরিবর্তে comma বসবে।
- প্রথম বাক্যের কর্তা বসবে।
- দ্বিতীয় বাক্যের বাকি অংশ বসবে।

English-Wizard.question: ৮) Sabbir was too weak to walk. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: Sabbir was so weak and could not walk.
English-Wizard.option2: Sabbir was very weak and can not walk.
English-Wizard.option3: Sabbir was very weak so could not walk.
English-Wizard.option4: Sabbir was very weak and could not walk.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Simple to Compound:

• Simple sentence এ too + adjective + to + verb থাকলে Compound এ too এর স্থলে very এবং that এর স্থলে and বসে।

Simple sentence: Sabbir was too weak to walk.
Compound sentence: Sabbir was very weak and could not walk.

English-Wizard.question: ৯) The idiom "At the outset" means -
English-Wizard.option1: The beginning
English-Wizard.option2: At outside
English-Wizard.option3: Towards the end
English-Wizard.option4: In the middle
English-Wizard.exp:
• The idiom "At the outset" means - The beginning.

• At the outset
English Meaning: the beginning.
Bangla Meaning: শুরুতেই / প্রারম্ভেই

Ex. Sentence: I told him at / from the outset I wasn't interested.
Bangla Meaning: আমি তাকে শুরুতেই বলেছিলাম যে আমি আগ্রহী নই।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ১০) Without studying hard, you will not pass. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: Study hard and you will not pass.
English-Wizard.option2: Study hard or so you will not pass.
English-Wizard.option3: Study hard yet so you will not pass.
English-Wizard.option4: Study hard or you will not pass.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Simple to compound: 
• Simple Sentence এ without থাকলে Compound করার সময়: 
- Without বাদ যাবে 
- প্রথম clause টির imperetive sentence হিসেবে বসবে অর্থাৎ 'Study hard'
- দুটি clause-এর মাঝে or/otherwise বসবে এবং
- শেষের clause-টি বসবে। 

Simple: Without studying hard, you will not pass.
Compound: Study hard or you will not pass.

English-Wizard.question: ১১) Which situation best exemplifies the meaning of the idiom "Keep the wolf from the door"?
English-Wizard.option1: Saving money for a future investment
English-Wizard.option2: Working hard to pay bills and afford basic needs
English-Wizard.option3: Avoiding risky situations
English-Wizard.option4: Guarding your home from intruders
English-Wizard.exp:
• The situation best exemplifies the meaning of the idiom "Keep the wolf from the door" is - Working hard to pay bills and afford basic needs.

• Keep the wolf from the door
English Meaning: to have just enough money to be able to eat and live.
Bangla Meaning: খেয়ে পড়ে বাঁচার জন্য পর্যাপ্ত অর্থ থাকা।

Ex. Sentence: I work part-time to pay the mortgage and keep the wolf from the door.
Bangla Meaning: বন্ধকগুলো পরিশোধ ও খেয়ে পড়ে বাঁচার জন্য আমাকে একটা খন্ডকালীন চাকুরীও করতে হয়।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ১২) The stolen car was found. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: The car which was stolen has been found.
English-Wizard.option2: The car which is stolen was found.
English-Wizard.option3: The car which was stolen is being found.
English-Wizard.option4: The car which was stolen was found.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Subject এর পরের verb টি past participle হলে Simple sentence কে Complex করার নিয়ম:
- Subject বসে।
- relative pronoun (who, which, that) বসে।
- tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- প্রদত্ত past participle থেকে sentence এর বাকি অংশ বসে।

Simple: The stolen car was found.
Complex: The car which was stolen was found.

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৩) We cannot but obey our parents. (Make it Affirmative)
English-Wizard.option1: We always have to obey our parents.
English-Wizard.option2: We should obey our parents.
English-Wizard.option3: We must obey our parents.
English-Wizard.option4: We can but disobey our parents.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Transformation এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Negative এ cannot but থাকলে Affirmative এ এর পরিবর্তে must বসে।

- Example -
Negative: We cannot but obey our parents.
Affirmative: We must obey our parents.

English-Wizard.question: ১৪) We work hard to earn money. (Compound)
English-Wizard.option1: We work hard to earn a lot of money.
English-Wizard.option2: We want to earn money and therefore we work hard.
English-Wizard.option3: We work hard and we want to earn money.
English-Wizard.option4: We work hard and so that we earn money.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Simple: We work hard to earn money.
• Compound: We want to earn money and therefore we work hard.

• Simple sentence এ to অথবা in order to থাকলে Compound sentence এ and so/and so/ and therefore বসাতে হয়।
- এক্ষেত্রে Clause গুলো উল্টে যাবে এবং প্রথম Clause এ ‘want to’ যোগ হবে।
- সে অনুসারে প্রদত্ত বাক্যের সঠিক compound form হবে - we want to earn money so/and so/ and therefore we work hard.

• Compound sentence-এ একের অধিক principal clause থাকে যাদেরকে co-ordinate clause বলা হয়।
- অর্থাৎ Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।
- এছাড়া Compound sentence এ সাধারণত and, or, but, yet, so, therefore, otherwise, else, both --- and , either --- or , neither — nor, not only --- but also ইত্যাদি co-ordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত থাকে।

English-Wizard.question: ১৫) Saiful wants to earn money. (Make it Complex)
English-Wizard.option1: Saiful wants that he will earn money.
English-Wizard.option2: As Saiful wants, he will earn money.
English-Wizard.option3: Saiful wants and so he will earn money.
English-Wizard.option4: Saiful wants so therefore he will earn money.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Simple: Saiful wants to earn money.
• Complex: Saiful wants that he will earn money.

• To + Verb - Object বা Object সদৃশ হলে Complex Sentence- এ that + Clause বসে।
এখানে To + Verb টি money- Noun এর অনন্তর্নিহিত Verb এর Object সদৃশ হয়েছে।

- মূল Clause এর Verb (wants) present Tense হওয়ায়, এ Clause টাও present Tense এ হবে।
- তবে to + verb সাধারণত Future Indicate করে, তাই এখানে Future (will) হবে। 
- তবে মনে রাখতে হবে, to + verb  যদি উদ্দেশ্য বুঝানোর জন্য আসে, তখন সাধারণত so that বা in order that যুক্ত Clause বসে।

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) Rafique is always on time. (Negative)
English-Wizard.option1: Rafique does not come late.
English-Wizard.option2: Rafique does not fail to come on time.
English-Wizard.option3: Rafique is never on time.
English-Wizard.option4: Rafique is never late.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Affirmative to Negative:
• Affirmative sentence এ always থাকলে negative sentence এ পরিণত করার ক্ষেত্রে - 
- always এর স্থানে never বসে 
- affirmative word টির বিপরীত শব্দ বসে। 

Affirmative: Rafique is always on time.
Negative: Rafique is never late.

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) The phrase "hard up" means -
English-Wizard.option1: Having firm beliefs
English-Wizard.option2: Experiencing physical discomfort
English-Wizard.option3: Being in a difficult situation financially
English-Wizard.option4: Being in a state of confusion or uncertainty
English-Wizard.exp:
• The phrase "hard up" means - Being in a difficult situation financially.

• Hard up (idiom): 
English Meaning: short of money / having very little money.
Bangla Meaning: দরিদ্র / অভাবগ্রস্থ / স্বচ্ছল নয়।

Ex. Sentence: I'm too hard up to buy fancy clothes.
Bangla Meaning: দামি দামি জামা কাপড় কেনার মত টাকাপয়সা নেই আমার।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question:
১৮) At no time did he admit to the crime, even though the evidence was overwhelming.
Here the phrase 'at no time' refers to -
English-Wizard.option1: never
English-Wizard.option2: immediately
English-Wizard.option3: after a long time
English-Wizard.option4: near in time
English-Wizard.exp:
• At no time did he admit to the crime, even though the evidence was overwhelming.
- Here the phrase 'at no time' refers to - never.

• At no time
English Meaning: never / not ever.
Bangla Meaning: কখনোই না।

Ex. Sentence: I shall do it at no time.
Bangla Meaning: আমি এটা কখনোই করবো না।

প্রশ্নে উল্লেখিত অন্য অপশন গুলোর মধ্যে -  
- At once
English Meaning: immediately.
Bangla Meaning: দেরি না-করে / এক্ষুনি।

- At length
English Meaning: after a long time.
Bangla Meaning: দীর্ঘ সময় পর।

- At hand
English Meaning: nearby / near in time or position.
Bangla Meaning: নিকটে, আসন্ন।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ১৯) I saw her at the time of playing. (Make it Complex)
English-Wizard.option1: I saw her in playing time.
English-Wizard.option2: I saw her when he played.
English-Wizard.option3: I saw her on playing time.
English-Wizard.option4: I saw her when she was playing.
English-Wizard.exp:
• যদি কোনো Simple Sentence এ at the time of থাকে, উক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex Sentence এ রূপান্তরের সময় -
- At the time of এর পরিবর্তে  when বসে।

Simple: I saw her at the time of playing.
Complex: I saw her when she was playing.

- এ বাক্যে প্রথম clause টি অপরিবর্তিত রয়েছে।
- তারপর At the time of এর পরিবর্তে  when বসেছে।
- এরপর প্রথম clause টির tense এর form অনুযায়ী 
- পরবর্তী Clause টি he was playing লিখা হয়েছে।

English-Wizard.question: ২০) Jamil wants to travel the world. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: Jamil wanted that he will travel the world.
English-Wizard.option2: As Jamil wants, he would travel the world.
English-Wizard.option3: Jamil wants that he would travel the world.
English-Wizard.option4: Jamil wants that he will travel the world.
English-Wizard.exp:
• To + Verb - Object বা Object সদৃশ হলে Complex Sentence এ that + Clause বসে।
এখানে To + Verb টি guitar- Noun এর অনন্তর্নিহিত Verb এর Object সদৃশ হয়েছে।

- মূল Clause এর Verb (wants) present Tense হওয়ায়, এ Clause টাও present Tense এ হবে।
- তবে to + verb সাধারণত Future Indicate করে, তাই এখানে Future (will) হবে। 
- তবে মনে রাখতে হবে, to + verb  যদি উদ্দেশ্য বুঝানোর জন্য আসে, তখন সাধারণত so that বা in order that যুক্ত Clause বসে।

Simple: Jamil wants to travel the world.
Complex: Jamil wants that he will travel the world.
